tool_args.rationale: The equal-input observation matches x_now exactly, while opposing step directions produce signed departures from that baseline that tend to diminish with horizon. Fit an exponentially relaxing step correction with state-modulated amplitude; the supplied observations do not show the specified chaotic-sign signature.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The paid fine trajectory batch already supplied additional step directions and horizons; the observed exact equal-input baseline and signed step deviations are adequate to fit a compact smooth candidate.

considered_alternatives.option: Single-mode Maxwell exponential with constant amplitude
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The deviation-to-step ratios vary substantially across observed states and horizons, so a constant-amplitude Maxwell term is too restrictive.
It does not target the observed temporal step-direction effect and is explicitly irrelevant to identifying this law.
